tool.name: app_store_reviews_search
tool.title: Apple App Store Reviews and App Metadata
tool.description:
Search the Apple App Store and return customer reviews with star ratings, review text, the app version each review was written against, and full app metadata - across any storefront.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/app-store-reviews-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; reads Apple's public search, lookup and review endpoints.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 5-30 seconds; Apple caps the public review feed at 500 reviews per app per storefront; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for iOS app reviews and ratings, App Store metadata, release-version sentiment, ASO and competitor research, or to pair with Android data for a cross-platform view.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for Android reviews (use 'google_play_reviews_search'), for employer reviews, for app download estimates, or for Mac-only titles.
- Named alternatives: Use 'google_play_reviews_search' for the Android half of the same product, 'google_maps_search' for business reviews, or 'youtube_video_search' for video sentiment.

search_query.description: Find apps by name or keyword, as you would in App Store search (e.g. 'language learning'). Omit when app_ids is given.

app_ids.description: Specific apps as numeric track IDs ('570060128'), bundle IDs ('com.duolingo.DuolingoMobile') or App Store URLs. Overrides search_query.

countries.description: Two-letter App Store storefronts to collect from, e.g. ['us','gb']. Reviews differ per storefront. Defaults to ['us'].

include_reviews.description: Collect reviews as well as app metadata. Set false for a fast metadata-only survey of a category.

max_reviews_per_app.description: Upper bound on reviews per app per storefront. Apple's public feed caps at 500. Defaults to 100.

min_rating.description: Keep only reviews at or above this star rating, e.g. 4 for positive quotes.

max_rating.description: Keep only reviews at or below this star rating, e.g. 2 for complaint mining.

recent_days.description: Keep only reviews posted within this many days, e.g. 30 for the last month.

max_results.description: Maximum rows to return and bill across every app and storefront. Defaults to 25.

results.description: App Store reviews, or app-metadata rows when include_reviews is false.

app_rating_count.description: Number of ratings behind that average.

app_updated.description: ISO timestamp the current version shipped.

review_id.description: Apple's review identifier, unique per storefront.

review_version.description: App version the review was written against.

review_updated.description: ISO timestamp the review was posted or edited.

readme_row: | **Apple App Store Reviews** | [`captainhandsome/app-store-reviews-search`](https://apify.com/captainhandsome/app-store-reviews-search) | app_name, review_rating, review_body, review_version, app_average_rating | iOS review mining, ASO research and cross-platform sentiment |
filter_audit: min_rating, recent_days: no prefill, no default - inert. max_rating carries default 5, which is the top of the star scale and therefore filters nothing; it exists because the fleet lint requires every max_* input to be bounded with a default. include_reviews defaults true (behaviour switch, not a filter); countries defaults to us (storefront selector, not a narrowing filter).
